summary: McDowell County, WV former tower; observers named in 1950, 1957 and 1960 clippings; listed as gone, with no build date or site description found.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks the tower Gone; no removal date or method found

staffing.status: observers named in 1950, 1957 and 1960 newspaper notices; no later record found

events.note: March 1950 notice reappoints observers for the designated towers; Berwind observer named as William Thompson of Berwind. Earliest record found, not necessarily the first staffing
October 1957 notice: observers to go on duty when hunting season starts; Mrs. Edwin Hall named for the Berwind tower
October 1960 item: all District Four towers manned; a Frank Fowler of Berwind is named in the same item

notes_for_editor: Brief record checked: coordinates, registration date and gone status match the sources; no corrections. The 1950-1960 staffing comes from reprinted newspaper notices (Raleigh Register and Beckley Post-Herald, as credited by Forest Lookouts); the originals were not checked. No build date, design, fires or removal date found. Story leaves access and visit facts out because no source states them.
